question: Can deterministic property-support routing retain shared-property transfer while reducing edit-only negative transfer?
baseline: completed fresh joint rank-16 LoRA at 10k examples per mode
initialization: fresh rank-16 LoRA from the same unadapted backbone

data.train: byte-identical train.joint.jsonl from the completed 10k baseline
data.denovo_gate: byte-identical 120-request Raw@1 gate from the 10k baseline
data.editing_gate: byte-identical 500-request Raw@1 gate from the 10k baseline

method.adapter: one standard PEFT LoRA with deterministic masks over its rank axis
method.routing: the prompt-visible property names activate a fixed union of rank slots
method.normalization: each binary mask is scaled to squared L2 norm 16

evaluation.primary: Edit-only-5 strict success at source similarity 0.65

reporting: report all endpoints regardless of outcome
